name: reclaim-cause-attribution-collapsed
body: `reclaim_stale_socket` classifies pending state first and reaches the shape probe only when that is false, so an unreadable database is logged as "carries pending state" rather than as unreadable or shape-mismatched; the rebuild is identical and fail-closed either way. Upgrade to a finer cause split if operators need the log to distinguish an unreadable database from a dirty one.
